# HeaderFooter

```csharp
public sealed class HeaderFooter
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

A printed header or footer: its left, centre and right sections, in Excel's codes. Text prints as written, apart from codes such as [HeaderFooter.PageNumber](SharpCell.HeaderFooter.md#pagenumber) (`&P`), `&B` for bold or `&"Arial,Italic"` for a font; `&&` prints one ampersand, and [HeaderFooter.Escape](SharpCell.HeaderFooter.md#escape-string) doubles those of plain text. Null or empty leaves a section blank.

A printed header or footer: its left, centre and right sections, in Excel's codes. Text prints as written, apart from codes such as [HeaderFooter.PageNumber](SharpCell.HeaderFooter.md#pagenumber) (`&P`), `&B` for bold or `&"Arial,Italic"` for a font; `&&` prints one ampersand, and [HeaderFooter.Escape](SharpCell.HeaderFooter.md#escape-string) doubles those of plain text. Null or empty leaves a section blank.

**Parameters**

- `Left`: The section on the left, or null.
- `Center`: The section in the middle, or null.
- `Right`: The section on the right, or null.

<a id="parse-string"></a>
### Parse(string)

```csharp
public static HeaderFooter Parse(string code)
```

Splits a header or footer as an .xlsx file stores it, such as `&LLeft&CMiddle`, into its sections. Text before any section code belongs to the middle, as in Excel.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentNullException`: The text is null.
